data.one_liner: Generates random placeholder sentences and paragraphs for UI design.
data.what_it_does: Generates random sentences and paragraphs using a list of approximately 4000 Latin words. Up to two commas are inserted per sentence with shorter words favoured 50% of the time to produce a natural-looking placeholder text.
use_when: You need placeholder text for designing user interfaces
You want to generate random sentences and paragraphs in Flutter
avoid_when: You need actual valid Latin text
You require advanced localization or real content generation
strengths: Easy to use with a simple function call
Supports custom paragraph and word counts
weaknesses: Limited feature set beyond basic lorem ipsum generation
